answer: Each crystal is a fake identity. The river anchors it, and the river rejects any crystal sharing an attested tenure record. A crystal has influence equal to its tenure squared, and the river admits a crystal only when influence is at least the population squared. Thus the kth admitted crystal must burn k ember, one per attested epoch, so k clones cost 1+2+...+k ember. Parallel clones cannot share one tenure. It breaks if one tenure record supports another crystal. Call this population-quorum tenure.
